subject.title: [Feature]: Add safe UI diagnostics to the Control UI debug page

question: Which browser/runtime/display/accessibility/media facts may the authenticated Debug page collect and show without exposing identifiers, credentials, URLs, or persistent browser state?
rationale: The issue is intentionally privacy-scoped, and choosing the exact allowlist and whether media-device probing is acceptable changes the security boundary and support contract.

options.title: Narrow authenticated allowlist
options.body: Implement only coarse, non-identifying facts on the authenticated Debug page, excluding raw URLs, user-agent strings, hostnames, device IDs/labels, prompts, transcripts, tokens, and storage contents.

options.title: Defer media-device facts
options.body: Ship runtime/display/accessibility/browser-capability rows first and leave microphone/camera/device enumeration to a later Talk diagnostics decision.

options.title: Keep current diagnostics only
options.body: Leave browser environment collection out of core and rely on current gateway snapshots, logs, and manual support instructions.

recommendation.title: Narrow authenticated allowlist
recommendation.body: Implement only coarse, non-identifying facts on the authenticated Debug page, excluding raw URLs, user-agent strings, hostnames, device IDs/labels, prompts, transcripts, tokens, and storage contents.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the Debug/settings surface and authored this privacy-scoped feature request.
